QuestInfo.name: Magician of Hope
QuestInfo.0: If you completed your 2nd Job Advancement, visit the Maple Administrator.
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Administrator congratulated you for making your Job Advancement as a Magician during the rise of the Wise Man's Star. As a reward, you received the EXP Buff Item and a scroll.
QuestInfo.2: The Maple Administrator congratulated you for making your Job Advancement as a Magician during the rise of the Wise Man's Star. As a reward, you received the EXP Buff Item and a scroll.

0.0: Congratulations on making your 2nd Job Advancement! You were lucky to make your Job Advancement with the Wise Man's Star at its peak. This is a special gift that will surely double your joy. Would you like it right now?

yes.0: Behold! This #b#t2450028##k increases your EXP by 1.5 times, and comes with a #bScroll for Magic Attack#k. This is just what a rising Magician needs. If you make your 3rd or 4th Job Advancement before the Wise Man's Star rises on October 18, you could get another gift. Challenge yourself!
